svg.title: US119 — Complete a record stored in another replica (command executed by the owner)

g.text: US119 — Complete a record stored in another replica (command executed by the owner)
not in the future; cost >= 0; duration > 0 (else 400)
(peer request from maintenance-2; also to maintenance-1)
[no other ongoing record and every peer answered]
[another record ongoing, or a peer did not answer]
404 from a peer = "not mine" → next peer;
4xx from the owner → same status to the client
A record is only written by its owner replica, so there is a single version of each record.
The same forwarding is used by US217 (PATCH /component). No owner found → 404.
